title: 第1章 生存与绝望第2章 名将初展露
content_zh:
第一章 生存与绝望
来袭的，首先是闻风而至的黄巾军。
三国历史，是自黄巾之乱开始。东汉中期以来，由于豪族地主大量兼并土地，外戚和宦官轮流专权，政治极端腐败黑暗，加以自然灾害相继不断，使农民陷于死亡的境地。因此，从汉安帝即位以来，到黄巾起义爆发前夕，共计七十余年的时间，农保起义几乎连续不断。仅在黄巾起义前的三十余年中，见于史书记载的农民起义就不下二十余次。全国各地农民起义浪潮的普遍高涨，预示着一场更大规模的、全国性的革命风暴即将来临。这就是张角领导的黄巾大起义。
张角，本是道教中太平道一派的首领。他自称“大贤良师”，以传布太平道为名，利用行医治病为手段，在农民中秘密进行组织起义的活动。开始，东汉政府认为，太平道是劝人为善的“善道”，并没有引起注意，使太平道得以顺利的发展。张角继续扩大组织的范围，派遣八名弟子，分别到各地进行传道。经过十几年的努力，参加太平道的人越来越多，遍及青、徐、幽、冀、兖、豫、荆、扬八个州，入道群众达几十万人之多。为了将分散在各地的力量组织起来，他们把人道群众编为三十六方，大方一万多人，小方六七千人，每方立一“渠帅”，由张角统一指挥。
眼看时机一天天成熟，他们决定在“甲子”年发动起义，还颁布了四句口号，即“苍天已死，黄天当立，岁在甲子，天下大吉。”“苍天”就是指东汉，“黄天”则是张角自称。同时，他们又派人在京城洛阳的寺门及州郡官府的墙上，用白土写上“甲子”两个大字，作为起义的暗号和标志。
公元184年，大方马元义先调剂、扬二州的数万名起义群众，赶到邺县集中，准备配合京城及各地的起义。马元义又几次到洛阳，组织宦官封諝、徐奉等为内应，约定在这年的三月五日一同起义。但是在二月间，起义军内部出了叛徒唐周，把马元义的起义计划向东汉政府告密。东汉政府立即采取措施，首先在洛阳实行大搜捕，对起义进行残酷的镇压。结果，马元义被捕，在洛阳牺牲；信奉太平道的一千多名官兵、百姓，也遭到了屠杀。同时，东汉政府又下令冀州官府，搜捕张角等人。
张角知道事情已经泄露，就连夜派人通知各方，立即举行起义。起义军头上都裹着黄巾，作为标记，因此称之为“黄巾军”。这次有组织、有准备的农民大起义，终于提前在二月爆发了。黄巾起义爆发后，张角自称“天公将军”，他的弟弟张宝称“地公将军”，张梁称“人公将军”，统一指挥战斗。他们率领起义军攻打州郡，焚烧官府，没收豪族财物，许多地方官吏闻风逃窜。不到十天时间，全国各地纷纷响应，京师为之震动。
三国游戏，也大多遵循了这个规律。热血三国游戏一开始，玩家出现的时候，就是处于黄巾之乱的时期，因为遭受了各地官府和豪强的镇压，黄巾军已经走入末途，只有到处抢掠才能维系自己的生存。
秦岚的城池，因为升到了五级，开始初具规模并且名声显露，引起其它势力的注意，又因为钱财无数，在一出现就瞬间就成为徐州巨贾，顿时让四处抢掠的黄巾军蜂拥而至。所幸的是，因为事发突然，这些黄巾军还没有来的及形成规模，所以，这一批来袭的黄巾军只有数千之众，还是最差的黄巾兵。
但是，哪怕是这一点点的兵力也会对新生的咸阳城产生巨大的威胁，因为城中根本就没有兵力。城中的兵营现在只有一个升到了5级，其他的还是在二三级徘徊，而且，大多数的人力都用来投于生产，所以，姜维根本就没有招募到什么兵力。
可是，秦岚从官府中走出来的时候，身为主将的姜维已经带着他的部下们走出了城墙，并且开始布防。
迅速的赶到城墙上，秦岚顿时大摇其头。名将卡就是名将卡，尽管是有胆有谋且身为蜀汉第五代执政大臣的姜维的影子，但是红卡姜维依然逃脱不了僵化的命运。
所有的兵种竟然被排成一线阵型，站在城外准备迎接敌人。天啊，这样的话，如果对方有快速移动的兵种，比如轻骑兵，几乎就是一个碰面就全军覆没的结局。
秦岚立刻张口大喊，“姜维听令！！”
“末将在！”好在，名将卡开出名将虽然呆板，但是忠心而且不会对主人产生不满，会完美的执行主人的所有命令。
“所有人立刻回城！”
“是！”
虽然咸阳城目前只有4级的城墙，并不高大，但是也绝对不是数千黄巾军就能轻易的攻打下来的。身为守军，不借助城墙的优势，反而出城去迎敌，秦岚是哭笑不得，这个红卡姜维……
“弓箭手站在城墙上抛射，其他兵种来回巡视，严防这群黄巾军爬上城墙。”秦岚很迅速的下达了防守命令，因为此刻，视野所及的地方，黄色旗帜的黄巾兵已经大摇大摆的出现了。
黄巾兵，其实大多数就是一些拿着简易武器的农民，他们扎着黄色的头巾，一窝蜂的向着咸阳城的城门涌来，一边还兴奋的嗷嗷叫着，似乎咸阳城就是一只待宰的羔羊。

只是，等到他们冲进城墙一千多米范围的时候，城墙上的箭塔就开始发威了，只是一轮劲射，三四百的黄巾军就倒在了血泊之中。这些黄巾兵，居然傻头傻脑的停下了脚步，他们惊骇的看到冲在前面的队友已经变成了冷冰冰的尸体，顿时发了懵。可是战场上，那里有这个时间给你？
箭塔的第二轮攻击再次发出，又是三四百的黄巾兵惨叫着倒下，剩下的那些顿时惊惶的尖叫而逃。秦岚在城墙上准备了半天，他甚至已经调度了十个轻骑在城门口等候，只要城墙下的黄巾兵被杀到一定数目，轻骑就会冲出……但是，这一切都随着黄巾兵的逃窜而宣告无效。秦岚傻眼，这不是热血三国的游戏吗，那些兵怎么可能会逃跑？？
可现在，他看到了什么？黄巾兵在重逢时的兴奋，死亡那一瞬间的绝望，淋漓尽致的表现在每一个人的脸上，还有那些幸存者的仓惶……这哪里还是游戏？明明就是一个活生生的世界！！
ps。求推荐……
content_en:
Chapter 1 Survival and Despair
The first to attack were the Yellow Turban Army who heard the news.
The history of the Three Kingdoms began with the Yellow Turban Rebellion. Since the middle of the Eastern Han Dynasty, due to the large-scale annexation of land by wealthy landlords, the rotation of relatives and eunuchs in power, extreme political corruption and darkness, and the continuous natural disasters, farmers were in a state of death. Therefore, from the time Emperor An of the Han Dynasty came to the throne to the eve of the Yellow Turban Uprising, for a total of more than 70 years, the Peasant Rebellion Uprising was almost continuous. In the thirty years before the Yellow Turban Uprising alone, there were no less than twenty peasant uprisings recorded in historical records. The general rise of peasant uprisings across the country heralds the coming of a larger-scale, nationwide revolutionary storm. This was the Yellow Turban Uprising led by Zhang Jiao.
Zhang Jiao was originally the leader of the Taiping Dao sect in Taoism. He claimed to be a "great virtuous teacher", and in the name of spreading the Tao of Taiping, he secretly organized uprisings among farmers by practicing medicine and treating diseases. At first, the Eastern Han Dynasty government believed that Taiping Dao was a "good road" that encouraged people to do good, and did not attract attention, allowing Taiping Dao to develop smoothly. Zhang Jiao continued to expand the scope of the organization and sent eight disciples to preach in various places. After more than ten years of hard work, more and more people are participating in Taiping Taoism, covering the eight prefectures of Qing, Xu, You, Hebei, Yan, Henan, Jing, and Yang, with hundreds of thousands of people joining the Taoism. In order to organize the scattered forces in various places, they organized the humanitarian masses into thirty-six parties, with more than 10,000 people in the large party and six to seven thousand people in the small party. Each party established a "Qu Commander", under the unified command of Zhang Jiao.
Seeing that the time was ripe day by day, they decided to launch an uprising in the year of Jiazi, and promulgated four slogans, namely, "Cangtian is dead, Huangtian is here to stand, and in Jiazi, the world will be auspicious." "Cangtian" refers to the Eastern Han Dynasty, and "Huangtian" is Zhang Jiao's self-proclaimed name. At the same time, they sent people to write the two characters "Jia Zi" in white clay on the temple gates and the walls of the prefecture and county offices in Luoyang, the capital, as a code and symbol of the uprising.
In 184 AD, Dafang Ma Yuanyi first mobilized tens of thousands of uprising people from two states and rushed to Ye County to gather in preparation for cooperating with the uprising in the capital and other places. Ma Yuanyi went to Luoyang several times and organized the eunuchs Feng Xu, Xu Feng and others as internal responders, and agreed to revolt together on March 5 of that year. However, in February, a traitor named Tang Zhou emerged from within the rebel army, and he reported Ma Yuanyi's uprising plan to the Eastern Han government. The Eastern Han government immediately took measures, first conducting a large-scale raid in Luoyang and brutally suppressing the uprising. As a result, Ma Yuanyi was arrested and died in Luoyang; more than a thousand officers, soldiers and civilians who believed in Taiping Road were also massacred. At the same time, the Eastern Han government ordered the Jizhou government to search for Zhang Jiao and others.
Zhang Jiao knew that the matter had been leaked, so he sent people overnight to notify all parties and immediately launched an uprising. The rebels all wore yellow scarves on their heads as a mark, so they were called the "Yellow Turban Army." This organized and well-prepared peasant uprising finally broke out in February ahead of schedule. After the Yellow Turban Uprising broke out, Zhang Jiao called himself "General Tiangong", his younger brother Zhang Bao called himself "General Digong", and Zhang Liang called himself "General Renggong" to unified command the battle. They led the rebel army to attack prefectures and counties, burned government offices, confiscated the property of wealthy families, and many local officials fled after hearing the news. In less than ten days, all parts of the country responded, and the capital was shocked.
Most of the Three Kingdoms games also follow this rule. At the beginning of the game "Hot Blooded Three Kingdoms", when the player appears, he is in the period of the Yellow Turban Rebellion. Due to the suppression by local officials and powerful people, the Yellow Turban Army has reached its end and can only maintain its survival by looting everywhere.
Because Qin Lan's city had been promoted to the fifth level, it began to take shape and its reputation was revealed, attracting the attention of other forces. And because of its countless money, he instantly became a wealthy businessman in Xuzhou as soon as it appeared, and immediately attracted a swarm of looting Yellow Turban troops. Fortunately, because the incident happened suddenly, theseThe Yellow Turban Army has not yet formed a large scale, so this batch of attacking Yellow Turban Army only has a few thousand people, and they are still the worst Yellow Turban Army.
However, even this small amount of troops will pose a huge threat to the newly born Xianyang City, because there are no troops in the city at all. Only one of the barracks in the city has been upgraded to level 5, and the others are still hovering at level 2 or 3. Moreover, most of the manpower is used for production, so Jiang Wei has not recruited any troops at all.
However, when Qin Lan walked out of the palace, Jiang Wei, the commander-in-chief, had already led his men out of the city wall and began to set up defenses.
Quickly rushing to the city wall, Qin Lan suddenly shook his head. A famous general card is a famous general card. Although it is the shadow of Jiang Wei, the courageous and scheming minister of the fifth generation of the Shu Han Dynasty, the red card Jiang Wei still cannot escape the rigid fate.
All the troops were actually lined up in a line formation, standing outside the city ready to meet the enemy. Oh my god, in this case, if the opponent has fast-moving units, such as light cavalry, it will almost end up being annihilated in one encounter.
Qin Lan immediately opened his mouth and shouted, "Jiang Wei obeys the order!!"
"The last general is here!" Fortunately, if the famous general is dull, he is loyal and will not be dissatisfied with his master. He will perfectly execute all the master's orders.
"Everyone return to the city immediately!"
"Yes!"
Although Xianyang City currently only has a level 4 wall, which is not very tall, it is definitely not something that thousands of Yellow Turbans can easily attack. As a defender, instead of taking advantage of the city wall, he went out to meet the enemy. Qin Lan was dumbfounded. This red card Jiang Wei...
"The archers stood on the city wall to shoot, and other troops patrolled back and forth to prevent this group of Yellow Turbans from climbing up the city wall." Qin Lan quickly issued a defensive order, because at this moment, as far as the field of vision could be seen, the Yellow Turbans with yellow flags had already appeared swaggering.
In fact, most of the Yellow Turban Soldiers were farmers armed with simple weapons. They wore yellow turbans and swarmed towards the gate of Xianyang City, shouting excitedly, as if Xianyang City was a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.
However, when they rushed into the city wall more than a thousand meters away, the arrow towers on the city wall began to show their power. With just one round of fire, three to four hundred Yellow Turban troops fell into a pool of blood. These yellow scarf soldiers actually stopped stupidly. They were horrified to see that their teammates rushing in front had turned into cold corpses, and they were immediately stunned. But on the battlefield, where is the time for you?
The second round of attacks from the arrow tower was launched again, and another three to four hundred Yellow Turban soldiers fell down screaming, and the remaining ones immediately screamed in panic and ran away. Qin Lan had been preparing on the city wall for a long time. He had even arranged for ten Qingqi to wait at the city gate. As long as a certain number of Yellow Turban soldiers were killed under the city wall, the Qingqi would rush out... However, all this was in vain as the Yellow Turban soldiers fled. Qin Lan was dumbfounded. Isn't this a game about the Three Kingdoms? How could those soldiers escape? ?
But now, what did he see? The excitement of the Yellow Turban soldiers when they reunited, the despair at the moment of death, are vividly reflected on everyone's face, as well as the panic of the survivors... Where is this still a game? It is obviously a living world! !
